reviews.title: Nice quality power supply
reviews.comment:
I only buy Corsair power supplies, going on 20 years now, zero failures. This one is for my mom's new PC I built her and of course it works perfectly and was a joy to install.
Fully modular cables make it super easy to minimize wire mess, using only the connections I need for her simple build made a neat and tidy appearance easy.
The fan is quiet (I can't hear it at all, but it is spinning).
Really nice power supply if you don't need something to power a monster video card and a great value considering that it's fully modular and atx 3.1 compliant.
reviews.author: Rob Taylor
